stories.title: Maps show where Thanksgiving storms could impact holiday festivities, disrupt travel plans
stories.summary: Rain, snow and powerful winds were forecast to impact large stretches of the country on Thanksgiving, potentially disrupting holiday festivities and, in some areas, hampering travel plans.

stories.title: As Essence Festival leaves New Orleans, officials hold "extensive" talks to bring it to Baltimore
stories.summary: The Essence Festival of Culture is leaving New Orleans after more than 30 years, and officials in Maryland say they are holding "extensive discussions" to bring the festival to Baltimore.

stories.title: Maryland's Festival of Trees benefits Kennedy Krieger and students like 3rd grader Chozin
stories.summary: The Festival of Trees returns this weekend at the Maryland State Fairgrounds, and the proceeds benefit Kennedy Krieger programs and kids like 3rd grader Chozin Best, who went from a patient to a student.

stories.title: Cargo ship lost steering as it approached Maryland's Bay Bridge last week, pilot requested bridge closure
stories.summary: A cargo ship lost its steering ability last week while approaching the Chesapeake Bay Bridge, and the pilot notified Maryland transportation officials and requested a bridge closure, according to the Maryland Transportation Authority (MDTA).

stories.title: Thanksgiving nor'easter brings Maryland damaging winds, heavy rain and high tides
stories.summary: Thanksgiving 2026 could go down as the wettest on record as a strong nor'easter brings heavy rain, damaging winds, and high tides to Maryland.

stories.title: Bea Gaddy Thanksgiving dinner reaches 45 years in Baltimore
stories.summary: WJZ-TV's Dennis Valera says volunteers were still needed Thursday.

stories.title: Nor'easter in Maryland Thursday, rain Friday, weekend looks great
stories.summary: WJZ-TV meteorologist Steve Sosna has your latest weather forecast.

stories.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed until Saturday due to weather for first time in its 100-year history
stories.summary: For the first time in history, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed due to weather, Macy's said Wednesday.

stories.title: First Alert Weather: Nor'easter set to impact Maryland on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: CBS News Baltimore's Cutter Martin has the latest weather forecast.

stories.title: Baltimore in talks to become new home of Essence Festival
stories.summary: The Essence Festival of Culture is leaving New Orleans after more than 30 years, and officials in Maryland say they are holding "extensive discussions" to bring the festival to Baltimore.

stories.title: 1 man dead, 1 in critical after South Baltimore shooting
stories.summary: Police are investigating a deadly shooting that happened Wednesday night in South Baltimore.

stories.title: Thanksgiving storm adds to holiday travel stress in Baltimore and beyond
stories.summary: Maryland is preparing for a Thanksgiving nor'easter that could lead to power outages and travel restrictions. CBS News Baltimore's Caroline Foreback reports from BWI airport.
